other_failure_modes.name: LGBM_multiclass_predict_bug
other_failure_modes.description: For LightGBM models using a multiclass objective, the predict method returns a 2D array of class probabilities, not 1D class labels. Rounding these probabilities instead of using np.argmax(..., axis=1) leads to incorrect shapes and values, which will crash when passed to a metric like accuracy_score alongside 1D true labels.

y_pred = np.round(y_pred).astype(int)

other_failure_modes.name: Early_stopping_without_validation_set
other_failure_modes.description: Using an early stopping callback in LightGBM (or XGBoost) requires at least one validation dataset to evaluate the stopping metric. Supplying the callback without passing `valid_sets` during training will cause the code to crash.
